item.title: Sikh student assaulted after being mistaken for ‘Hindu’ at San Jose State University, Hindu groups condemn attack
item.description: A Sikh student at San Jose State University was assaulted and had his turban torn off, with attackers reportedly using "Hindu" as a slur. Hindu advocacy groups condemned the attack, citing anti-Hindu bias and overlapping vulnerabilities faced by Sikh and Hindu students. The incident has prompted calls for enhanced campus security and awareness programs.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Is religion declining? 1 in 4 worldwide now non-religious, becomes third-largest group as Christianity falls
item.description: Nearly one in four people worldwide now identify with no religion, according to a sweeping global study covering 201 countries. The religiously unaffiliated grew by 270 million between 2010 and 2020, reaching 1.9 billion, driven largely by disaffiliation from Christianity. While Christians remain the largest group, only Muslims and the unaffiliated increased their global population share.

item.title: Meet Julian Miramontes: 14-year-old California boy who built an app to help immigrants know their rights during ICE raids
item.description: A 14-year-old Los Angeles student, Julian Miramontes, has developed a mobile app, 'Know Your Rights,' to empower immigrants by explaining their legal protections. This innovative tool, which won the Congressional App Challenge, uses simple language and quizzes to demystify complex rights, aiming to reduce fear and uncertainty within his community.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump would agree to meeting with Iran's Ayatollah Khamenei, says Marco Rubio
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated President Trump would meet Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei if the opportunity arose, signaling a willingness for dialogue. Rubio emphasized Trump's preference for resolving conflicts through negotiation, while also asserting Iran will not be allowed to possess nuclear weapons.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “After Charlie was…”: Candace Owens ignites firestorm after claiming Erika Kirk’s “biggest donor” is a Scientologist
item.description: Candace Owens has stirred fresh controversy after claiming that Erika Kirk’s “biggest donor” is a Scientologist. The allegation, posted on X without evidence, has intensified tensions within conservative circles and Turning Point USA. Critics say the remark fuels religious suspicion and internal division, while supporters argue it raises questions about transparency and influence inside prominent right-wing organizations.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: “I want to apologize”: Kai Cenat addresses viral cheating speculation following Gigi Alayah breakup
item.description: Kai Cenat has addressed rumors surrounding his breakup with Gigi Alayah, urging fans not to believe speculation circulating online. In a now-deleted Instagram statement, he apologized for staying silent and said any real updates would come directly from him. The split, confirmed in late 2025, sparked cheating allegations and online drama, which both sides have publicly denied.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: Is IShowSpeed planning a massive international tour after teasing “airlines” during his 51 million subscriber livestream?
item.description: IShowSpeed has sparked global speculation after teasing his next tour with the single word “airlines” during a livestream. The hint came as he tracked his push toward 51 million YouTube subscribers. Following his 28-day Africa tour, fans now believe he may be planning another international trip, with guesses ranging from Australia to the Middle East and South America.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: What is Twitch’s Plus Program? New payout system explained as creators worry about the 70/30 split
item.description: Twitch’s new Plus Program introduces a two-level revenue system where creators earn subscription-based Plus Points to unlock payout tiers, including a 70/30 split. Some streamers feared they would lose their existing deals, but Twitch said historical contracts remain unchanged. The update aims to standardize payouts, though confusion among creators has sparked widespread online discussion and concern.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: ‘Third world aliens are coming through H1B visas’: Texas activist targets Hindu temple in viral post
item.description: A Texas activist's social media post linking a Hindu temple to a cultural 'invasion' via H-1B visas has ignited debate. The post, featuring the Karya Siddhi Hanuman Temple, drew criticism for its inflammatory language and misrepresentation of immigration. This controversy highlights ongoing discussions about skilled immigration and its impact on local communities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: BNP’s landslide brings anti-India leaders to mainstream; casts shadow on Dhaka-Delhi ties
item.description: Bangladesh's elections bring the BNP to power with a decisive mandate, but the return of controversial leaders with past convictions and alleged anti-India links complicates regional ties. The new government's push for former PM Sheikh Hasina's extradition from India presents an immediate diplomatic challenge, signaling a potential shift in bilateral relations.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: 'PM Modi should be invited': BNP's diplomatic tone ahead of Tarique Rahman’s swearing-in
item.description: Bangladesh Nationalist Party leader ANM Ehsanul Hoque Milan suggested inviting Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to the swearing-in ceremony of BNP chief Tarique Rahman, who is set to become the next Prime Minister. The BNP secured a landslide victory in the general elections, marking their return to power after nearly two decades.
